name: [PayFlow Hackathon] 13 - PayPal Invoicing v2 & Deterministic Control

parameters.query:
SELECT
      (SELECT config_value FROM payflow_config WHERE config_key = 'engine_secret_sha256') AS secret_hash,
      (SELECT config_value FROM payflow_config WHERE config_key='operator_assertion_public_key') AS operator_public_key,
      (SELECT config_value FROM payflow_config WHERE config_key='public_origin') AS public_origin,
      COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(t) FROM (SELECT id,customer_company,status,total_amount,computed_margin_pct FROM payflow_orders ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100) t),'[]'::json) AS portfolio,
      COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(p ORDER BY p.id) FROM payflow_products p WHERE p.is_active = TRUE), '[]'::json) AS catalog,
      (SELECT row_to_json(o) FROM payflow_orders o WHERE o.id = '{{ /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,48}$/.test(String($json.body?.order_id || $json.order_id || "")) ? String($json.body?.order_id || $json.order_id) : "" }}') AS target_order,
      COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(i ORDER BY i.id) FROM payflow_order_items i WHERE i.order_id = '{{ /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,48}$/.test(String($json.body?.order_id || $json.order_id || "")) ? String($json.body?.order_id || $json.order_id) : "" }}'), '[]'::json) AS target_items,
      (SELECT row_to_json(inv) FROM payflow_invoices inv WHERE inv.order_id = '{{ /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,48}$/.test(String($json.body?.order_id || $json.order_id || "")) ? String($json.body?.order_id || $json.order_id) : "" }}') AS target_invoice;

Actual catalogue (SKU, prices/costs per case, limits, stock): " + (JSON.stringify($('Postgres: Load Context & State').first().json.catalog)) + "
Actual portfolio (order volumes, not payment receipts): " + (JSON.stringify($('Postgres: Load Context & State').first().json.portfolio)) + "
Action: " + ($('Webhook PayFlow Engine').first().json.body.action) + "
User request JSON: " + (JSON.stringify($('Webhook PayFlow Engine').first().json.body.prompt)) + "
For action ai_studio_agent: analyse only the portfolio above, then return {"executive_reasoning":"Precise analysis in English","studio_command":{"recommended_view":"studio","status_filter":"ALL or PENDING_APPROVAL or APPROVED or INVOICE_SENT or PAID or BLOCKED_ANOMALY or REJECTED according to the request","assistant_reply":"Response in English grounded in these figures"}}. Do not invent payment receipts.

parameters.content:
# 1 · Entrée et sécurité
Charger le contexte, vérifier la session opérateur.

**Session invalide → réponse de refus dans le bloc 4.**

# 2 · Routage et PayPal
Action PayPal : réserver l’émission et obtenir l’authentification Sandbox.

**Demande IA → bloc 3. Sinon → moteur commun, bloc 4.**

# 3 · Assistant IA
Gemini pour le Copilot et AG Studio. Modèle de secours si nécessaire.

**L’IA propose ; le bloc 4 applique les règles métier.**

# 4 · Contrôles et résultat
Contrôles métier, actions PayPal, écriture atomique et vérification.

**Validation interne ≠ accord client ≠ paiement confirmé.**

# 5 · Expiration
**Automatique · toutes les 15 minutes**

Libérer les réservations des devis expirés sans paiement.

Branche indépendante du parcours principal.
